content: Torikotor gusol doya Yahya
Allar Fut, Isa Mosir kušir hóboror babute šuru,
Esaiyah nobir kitabot iyan zendilla leka ase:

content.text: "Sa, ãi tor age ãr hóborguware defeṛair,
hite tor age zai tolla fõt saf goribo."
"Bošoti sara elehat ek abaze guzori zanai der,

content: He mozin torikotor gusol doya Yahyaye bošoti sara elehat hazir oiye edde guna maf faibolla gunattu mon firaito edde torikotor gusol loito hoiye.
Ehudiya beggullattu edde Zeruzalemor hár kiye niyoliyore hibar hãse giye. Hitara hitarar guna okkolore šikar goijje edde Zordan halot hibattu torikotor gusol loiye.
Yahyaye uṛor kẽšor hoor findito edde kĩyailot ekkan samorar duwali takito, ar hibaye firing edde fahari modu háiyore zibon haṛaiye.
Hibaye endilla hoi tobolig goijje: "Ãi bade en ekzon aiyer ze ãttũwaro šoktiwala, edde ãi niyuriyore hibar zutar fita kúlidibar laikka o ãi no.
Ãi tũwarare fani loi torikotor gusol diyi, kintu hibaye tũwarare he Pak Ruh loi torikotor gusol dibo."
Isar torikotor gusol edde dúha
He šomot Isaye Galilor Nasarat farattu aišše, edde Yahyattu Zordan halot torikotor gusol loiye.
Hibaye fanittu uṛer mottor, asman fáṛi bag oiye edde dekedde Pak Ruh hoitoror ḍoilla oi hibar uwore lami aiyer.
Ar behostottu ei hota funa giye: "Tui ãr he adoijja Fut, tor uwore ãi kub kuši."
Iyar bade he Ruhuye hibare bošoti sara elehat loigiye,
ar hiba heṛe sališ din aššil edde šoitane dúha diye. Hiba heṛe fahari zanuwar okkolor fũwati aššil, edde hibare firista okkole šeba goijje.
Isaye hibar ham šuru goijje
Yahyare ziyolot diya oi bade, Isaye Galilot aišše edde Allar kušir hóbor tobolig goijje.
Hibaye hodde:

content.text: "Ṭaim oiye, Allar raijjo tũwarar hãse aišše.Tũwara mon firo edde ei kušir hóbor biššaš goro."

content: He foila sahabi okkol
Ek bar hibaye Galil doriyar hãsa bai gil, hen šomot hibaye Simon edde hitar bái Anderiyaze doriyat zal feledde deikke, kiyollahoile hitara aššilde zailla.
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Aiyo, ãr fisa lo, toi ãi tũwarare manuš doribar zailla banaiyum"

content: Hehon hitara hitarar zal okkol felai raki Isar fisa loiye.
Toi hentu ar hoddur mummikka zaiyore Sebdeusor futain Yakub edde hitar bái Yuhannare deikke, hitara not boiyore zal baz gorer.
Toi hitarare deki mottor hibaye ḍak diye, ar hitara hitarar baf Sebdeusore muzur okkolor fũwati not diyore bade itara Isar fisa loiye.
Isaye Kofornahumot bod ruh dafaiye
Tarfore hitara Kofornahumot aišše, toi bade zehon dórmo din oiye, Isaye sinagogot giye edde šikka diye.
Isar šikkat beggune tajjuf oiye, kiyollahoile hibaye alem okkolor ḍoilla gori šikka no de bolke hibaye hitarare kemota loi šikka diye.
Ehon, heṛe hitarar muzolišhanar butore bod ruhuye faiya ekzon manuš aššil. Hite ḍak mari hodde,
"Oh, Nasarator Isa, õne loi ãrar loi ki talukkat? Õne ki ãrare naš goitto aiššo? Ãi zani õne honnuwa, õne to Allar he Pak zon!"
Kintu Isaye hitare dõk diyore hodde,

content.text: "Nizam o, ei manušwar butottu niyoli ai."

content: Toi he bod ruhuye manušware doro gori musori doijje edde zure guzori hitar butottu niyoli giyegoi.
Ei hanḍo deki beggune tajjuf oiye edde hitara nizor butore howahoi goijje edde hodde, "In ki? Ek noya šikka, kemota loi! Hibaye bod ruh okkolore hokum de, ar hitara hibar hota mane."
Toi hibar babute hóbor beši toratori Galil elehar hár mikka sorai giyegoi.
Bade hitara muzolišhanattu niyoli zaigoi mottor, hitara Simon edde Anderiyazor górot giye. Yakub edde Yuhanna o hitarar fũwati aššil.
Heṛe Simonor hori zor biyaram loi bisanat fori taikke. Isa aišše mottor hitara hiyan hibare hoiye.
Toi Isa hibar ḍake zaiyore hibare hate dori tuille, henot hibattu zor sari giyegoi, ar hibaye hitarare mehemandari goijje.
Beil ḍufigiyegoi edde hazinna oiye, manušzon okkole har biyaraimma okkolore edde bod ruhuye faiya manuš okkolore Isar hãse ainne.
ar šohor ṭĩya aiyore dorozar munttu dola oiye.
Isaye hár ḍoilla biyaraimma okkolore aram goijje edde bod ruh dafaiye. Kintu hibaye bod ruh okkolore hono hota hoito no de, kiyollahoile hiba Moside hiyan hitara zainto.
Isaye duwa gorer edde tobolig gorer
Tarforor din binna sore, andar takite Isaye uiṭṭe edde niyoli ekkan nirzon zagat giye, zeṛe hibaye duwa goijje.
Kintu Simon edde hitara Isare tuwaito giye,
toi hitara hibare tuwai faiyore hodde, "Beggune õnor talaš gorer!"
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Aiyo, ãra eṛiyar ate hãsor fara okkolot zai, zene ãi heṛe o tobolig gori fari, hiyanolla to ãi aiššiyi."

content: Toi hibaye Galilor hár mikka giye, sinagog okkolot šikka diye, edde bod ruh okkolore dafaiye.
Ek kurus biyaraimmare Isaye aram goijje
Ek kurus biyaraimmaye Isar hãse aiyore hibar sarme fot uite fori foriyad goijje, "Õne issa gorile ãre foriškar gori fariba."
Manušwalla Isattu doya oiye, hat barai di hitare suiyore hodde,
Ar hehon hitattu kurus sari giyegoi edde hite foriškar oiye.
Isaye hitare hora gori nišod goijje edde en hoiyore hehon dũrai diye:

content.text: "Ei hota honokiyore no hois. Kintu zaiyore dórmiyo alem okkolore dehagoi, ar foriškar oi faijjosde hiyanolla Musar ain mozin kurbani gorgoi. Henot hitarar hãse tui foriškar oiyosde hiyanor forman oibo."

content: Kintu manušwaye zaiyore hár zagat ei hóbor en bafe sorai diye, ziyanor zoriya Isaye ar hono ekkan šohorot kulasa gori goli no fare, kintu baire nirzon zagat taikke. Tarfore o hár zagattu manuš okkol hibar hãse aišše.
